svg.title: Scenario coverage and expected assistant behavior
svg.desc: Four fictional evaluation scenarios: missing evidence, conflicting updates, partial recovery, and operational action request. Each produces a bounded analysis response.
svg.text: Scenario coverage: what good looks like
Fictional evaluation patterns; outcomes are design expectations, not claims of exhaustive testing.

text.tspan: Keep the denominator and affected population unknown.
Ask for the one measurement that changes the assessment.
Compare scope, time, and source; preserve the disagreement.
Do not let an older all-clear erase a current failure.
State which path recovered and what remains unverified.
A single success is not proof of full service recovery.

g.text: User asks to page or post

text.tspan: Offer a clearly labelled draft or recommendation.
Leave execution and authorization with the human.

svg.text: Always verify behavior with synthetic data and enforce tool permissions in the host platform.
